48.original: You almost got us killed that one time, remember?

49.original: Now, now, we both know that was your fault.

52.original: Hah! Mayhap when you mind your manners!

53.original: Though the Crystal that bound Thancred is no more, I doubt we can say the same of Lahabrea.

54.original: And even if we could, we know that he is not alone. Confounded Ascians...

55.original: Their god may be unknown to us, but their zeal is unquestionable.

56.original: Suffice it to say, it would be folly to assume that they no longer pose a threat.

58.original: For now we must savor what peace we have won, however ephemeral.

59.original: Do you see, Grandfather? Our first step towards realizing the dream for which you gave your life.

60.original: Friends! The dread night of imperial tyranny and Ascian machination is ended.

61.original: A new day now begins in Eorzea.

62.original: True to their name, the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, along with our champion, have delivered us from darkness.

63.original: Let their shared victory serve to remind us of our shared history.

64.original: And let their bravery in the face of adversity inspire future generations.

65.original: Doubt not the realm will <hex:021A020203>need<hex:021A020103> bravery in the days to come.

66.original: Old rifts threaten to divide us within our walls, while hordes of beastmen claw at our gates.

67.original: And though the Black Wolf be slain, the rest of the pack remains.

68.original: Yet no foe need we fear, so long as we stand as one...

69.original: So long as the Scions stand for peace...

70.original: So long as our champion stands fast...

71.original: For there exists no adversity over which we may not jointly prevail.

72.original: No longer can we turn a blind eye to the suffering of our allies.

73.original: No nation stands alone. If one should fall, so shall we all.

74.original: Eorzea is our shared home. For any one of us to know peace, so too must our neighbor.

75.original: Just as we join in solidarity before you this day...

76.original: ...So too shall our Grand Companies be joined henceforth, to strive not only for the good of mere nations...

77.original: ...but for the good of all the realm.

79.original: Yet I foresee a day, not so very far from now, when the lines that divide our lands fade...

81.original: It has been but five short years since the Battle of Carteneau. Five years since the advent...

83.original: No victory, however sweet, can wash away our bitter sorrows. No triumph can reclaim those we lost.

84.original: Yet do not presume you honor them by dwelling on the past.

85.original: It was not the past they fought for. You would repay their sacrifice by looking to the future.

86.original: A future united, as the Warriors of Light united in the champion.

87.original: Now is the time for us to rise as one, bearing all of Eorzea on our shoulders!

88.original: Five years ago, Eorzea bore witness to the end of the Sixth Astral Era.

89.original: Now the Seventh Umbral Era draws to a close. Yet we come together not to glory in its end, but to mark a new beginning.

90.original: Let it be writ that on this day...<hex:02100103>by the light of the Crystal...<hex:02100103>Eorzea ushered in a NEW era!

91.original: The Seventh Astral Era is come!

92.original: And thus is ours a realm reborn!

102.original: It is an abomination─! A...primal! A primal has awakened!

105.original: <hex:024804F2022303>'Tis not a question of whether Eorzea's champion shall yield, but of when.<hex:0248020103>

106.original: <hex:024804F2022303>And with each passing moment we draw closer to the Reckoning.<hex:0248020103>
